(1) Markers: case-insensitive grep for TODO|FIXME|XXX|CHANGE_ME|placeholder|TBD|lorem|author|note to self and for host paths (C:\, /Users/, /home/, F:/, turing-workspace) over instruction.md and both /instructions notes returned no hits; the template's 'CHANGE_ME' instruction placeholder is fully replaced. All three files are pure ASCII with LF endings (0 CR). (2) Spelling: extracted the full lowercase word list of the three files and reviewed it; every token is a real English word, product term (HireOps, SQLite, CDN, NODE_PATH) or seeded proper name. No misspellings. The only variation is British/US spelling: instruction.md:13 'honour'/'honouring' vs integration.md:7 'honoring' and hireops_rules.md section 8 'Honor' - both are valid spellings, not errors. (3) Paths: only intended contract paths appear (/app, /app/server.js, /app/app.db, /assets/seed_data.json, /instructions/hireops_rules.md, /instructions/integration.md, /app/node_modules, GET /api/health); all are agent-environment paths, none from an author machine. (4) Contradictions / duplicate facts: single password 'Hireops!2026' in instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md section 1; the account list in instruction.md:17 (3 recruiters, 3 hiring managers, 1 observer, 3 candidates) matches seed users exactly in emails and roles; port 3000 + PORT honoured (instruction.md:13) agrees with integration.md ('listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0') and rules section 8 (PORT in launch env); health 'never touches the database' (instruction.md:13) is compatible with integration.md 'answers before database work can block startup'; DB path /app/app.db + DB_PATH consistent across all three; one seed path throughout; 15-second update window identical (instruction.md:5 'fifteen seconds', rules section 5 '15 seconds'); page size 30 in rules section 6 matches seed thread_page_size 30; candidate wording table in rules section 7 matches seed candidate_status_labels exactly; rules section 9 'three jobs ... one conversation is long ... a few internal notes' matches seed (3 jobs, APP-101 has 120 messages, 3 notes). The activity example 'Mei Lin moved Priya Nair from Screen to Interview' uses seeded people (Priya Nair is seeded in SCREEN) and recruiters may move any card, so it is coherent. Brief-level undo ('as long as nobody has touched those cards since') is refined, not contradicted, by rules ('Adding a note does not count as a change', 'would overfill Interview'), and the brief explicitly defers exact rules to that file. No duplicated paragraphs. (5) Adversarial angle: a model cannot be misgraded by this row's content because no conflicting value exists for it to pick; a conforming app following either file reaches the same contract. Minor cosmetic observation only: hireops_rules.md is hard-wrapped at ~104 columns but lines 17, 99, 112, 173, 180 run to 107-169 chars and line 91 breaks mid-sentence ('...all the rules above,' / 'and Interview places...'), visible editing seams that render identically in Markdown and are not contamination or a spelling error.
